questions.question:
दिए गए कथन और निष्कर्षों को पढ़ें तथा सबसे उपयुक्त विकल्प का चयन कीजिए।

कथन:
न्यायमूर्ति यशवंत विष्णु चंद्रचूड़ भारत में सर्वोच्च न्यायालय के सबसे लंबे समय तक सेवा करने वाले मुख्य न्यायाधीश थे।
निष्कर्ष:
i) उन्होंने 7 वर्ष और 4 महीने तक, भारत के सर्वोच्च न्यायालय के मुख्य न्यायाधीश के रूप में कार्य किया।
ii) उन्होंने 1978 से 1985 तक सेवा की।
options: न तो निष्कर्ष (i) और न ही निष्कर्ष (ii) सही है।
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (निष्कर्ष (i) और (ii) दोनों सही हैं।) है।

questions.question: एक आगत में वृद्धि होने पर उत्पादन फलन पर निम्नलिखित में से क्या प्रभाव पड़ेगा?
options: आगत और निर्गत के बीच कोई संबंध नहीं है।
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (कुल निर्गत में वृद्धि होगी।) है।

questions.question: During April-October 2024, which country was India's top import source with $65.89 billion worth of inbound shipments, marking a 9.8% year-on-year increase?

Researchers from which of the following universities have revealed significant ecological degradations in the Veli-Akkulam Lake at the International Conference on Coastal Resilience (ECSA 60) in September 2024?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (University of Kerala) है।

questions.question: In which year was Sanskrit declared a Classical Language?
As per the Sample Registration System (SRS), the Maternal Mortality Ratio (MMR) has reduced from 8.1% in 2015-17 to ___________ in 2016-18 at the national level.
As of October 3, 2024, how many languages have been accorded the status of Classical Language in India?
Who was the first recipient of the Vigyan Ratna Puraskar?
The Landholders' Society was the first political association to be started in India in _________.
Which of the following is the correct equation for the net production taxes?
options: Total Production Taxes = Direct Taxes + Indirect Taxes
Net Production Taxes = Production Taxes – Production Subsidies
Net Production Taxes = Production Taxes + Production Subsidies
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (Net Production Taxes = Production Taxes – Production Subsidies) है।

questions.question: The Family Courts Act was enacted in which of the following years?
According to Dadabhai Naoroji, which of the following was the value of per capita income during 1867-1868?
In which of the following classical dance forms is the use of ‘ghungroos’ (ankle bells) to emphasise rhythmic footwork most prominent?
Nagarahole National Park is an important tiger reserve in _______ and is a major hub of conservation under Project Tiger and Project Elephant.
To which of the following components of GDP do consumer durable goods contribute?
The western coast, sandwiched between the Western Ghats and the ____________, is a narrow plain.
The ‘Hola Mohalla' festival, started by Guru Gobind Singh, is primarily celebrated in which of the following states of India?

Which state government held ‘Bal Sabhas’ in every village on 24 April 2022, which is observed as Panchayati Raj Day, to give children a platform to express their views and participate in the Panchayati Raj?
निम्नलिखित में से किस नीति/टूल का उद्देश्य डिफरेंशियल इंटरनेट मूल्य निर्धारण को सीमित करना और ऑनलाइन कंटेंट का समान व्यवहार (equal treatment) सुनिश्चित करना है?
options: स्वामित्व सामग्री थ्रॉटलिंग की अनुमति (Proprietary content throttling allowed)
केवल कुछ साइटों के लिए विशेष ISP बंडल (Exclusive ISP bundles only for some sites)
ओपन इंटरनेट एक्‍सेस को ब्‍लॉक करना (Blocking open internet access)
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (नेट न्यूट्रैलिटी रेगुलेशंस (Net Neutrality regulations)) है।

questions.question: Which of the following statements regarding the Central Council of Local Government is INCORRECT?
options: Originally, it was called the Central Council of Local Self-Government.
It was set up in 1954 under Article 263 of the Constitution of India.
Presently, it deals with both urban and rural local governments.
The Union Minister for Urban Development acts as the Chairman of the Council.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (Presently, it deals with both urban and rural local governments.) है।
